start: Member page of a member who left the gym

steps.action: Tap the red 'Archive member'

start: Member page of an archived member (the other direction)

steps.action: Tap 'Restore member'
user_sees: The button reads 'Archive member' in red
must_not: The plan dates changed by the restore

start: Member page; the internet is off

steps.action: Look at the Archive member button
must_not: An archive that looks done but never reaches the server

steps.action: With the internet on, tap it when the save fails
user_sees: A red banner with the reason; the pill and the button do not change
must_not: 'Member archived.' for a save that failed

start: Member page

steps.action: Archive, restore, archive again
user_sees: Each tap gives its toast and flips the pill and the button
must_not: The page and the Members list disagreeing about whether the member is archived

steps.action: Open the archived member again later
user_sees: Pill 'Archived'; all history still on the page
must_not: Expiry or dues reminders still going to an archived member

start: Member page of a member who left the gym; set-up: old saved data in the new version

steps.action: With Gym list record saved by the old version, update the app, then do "Archive or restore a member".
user_sees: The old Gym list record shown in full, with the same values as before the update
must_not: Old Gym list record missing, shown with empty or wrong fields, or changed without the user doing anything

steps.action: Tap the red 'Archive member'
must_not: Old Gym list record missing, shown with empty or wrong fields, or changed without the user doing anything

note: Members archived by an older version must still show the pill and the Restore button

start: Member page of a member who left the gym

steps.action: Tap the red 'Archive member'
Do step 1 of "Archive or restore a member" on one side (member app or gym panel); look at the same Gym list record on the other side.
user_sees: The other side shows the same facts, in its own words
must_not: The member and the gym seeing different facts about the Gym list record, or the member seeing what only the gym may see

note: What a member who uses the app sees after the gym archives them; a second panel showing the old state

start: Member page of a member who left the gym

steps.action: Tap the red 'Archive member'
Do step 1 of "Archive or restore a member" in the panel on a phone, with the same login open in the panel on a laptop.
user_sees: The laptop shows the change after a refresh or by itself
must_not: The laptop saving over the phone's change with old values, or the two never agreeing

note: What a member who uses the app sees after the gym archives them; a second panel showing the old state

start: Member page of a member who left the gym; set-up: money: part-paid

steps.action: Do "Archive or restore a member" for a member who has paid only part of what is due.
user_sees: Paid, due and total, and the three add up
must_not: The Gym list record shown as fully paid or fully unpaid, or a balance that does not add up

steps.action: Tap the red 'Archive member'
must_not: The Gym list record shown as fully paid or fully unpaid, or a balance that does not add up

note: Archiving a member who still owes money or whose plan is still running: there is no question first

start: Member page of a member who left the gym; set-up: dates at plan start and end

steps.action: Do "Archive or restore a member" for a membership that starts today, and again for one that ends today.
user_sees: Day counts that include both the first and the last day as the gym expects
must_not: A member shown as expired on the last paid day, or as active before the first day

steps.action: Tap the red 'Archive member'
must_not: A member shown as expired on the last paid day, or as active before the first day

note: Archiving a member who still owes money or whose plan is still running: there is no question first

start: Member page of a member who left the gym

steps.action: Tap the red 'Archive member'
Tap the main button of step 1 of "Archive or restore a member" twice, fast.
user_sees: One result; the button shows it is busy
must_not: Two rows of Gym list record, two charges, two messages sent, or two screens opened

note: The button does not grey while saving, so a second tap can restore the member straight away

start: Member page of a member who left the gym

steps.action: Tap the red 'Archive member'
Turn the internet off at step 1 of "Archive or restore a member", carry on, then turn it back on.
user_sees: A plain word that the work is saved on the device or could not be saved, and it is sent once when the internet is back
must_not: A lost Gym list record, a double Gym list record after the retry, or a success message for a save that failed

note: The button does not grey while saving, so a second tap can restore the member straight away

start: Member page of a member who left the gym

steps.action: Tap the red 'Archive member'
Two staff do step 1 of "Archive or restore a member" for the same Gym list record at the same time on two devices.
user_sees: One change wins and the other person is told, or both are kept
must_not: One person's change of Gym list record lost without a word, a double Gym list record, or two different truths on the two screens after a refresh

note: The button does not grey while saving, so a second tap can restore the member straight away

start: Member page of a member who left the gym; set-up: language

steps.action: Change the language setting, then do "Archive or restore a member".
user_sees: Every word of the journey in the chosen language
must_not: Mixed languages on one screen, a raw text key, or a Gym list record that changes meaning

steps.action: Tap the red 'Archive member'
must_not: Mixed languages on one screen, a raw text key, or a Gym list record that changes meaning

note: The button and toast words are fixed English

start: Member page of a member who left the gym; set-up: phone 360 px wide

steps.action: Do "Archive or restore a member" on a phone screen 360 px wide.
user_sees: Every word, figure and button of the journey in full
must_not: Cut-off text, a button off the screen, sideways scrolling, or two things on top of each other

steps.action: Tap the red 'Archive member'
must_not: Cut-off text, a button off the screen, sideways scrolling, or two things on top of each other

note: On a phone Archive member shares one row with Check in
